meta.title: Statistics 4 Bets · Football statistics to understand every match
meta.description: Goals, corners, cards, shots, fouls and referees by team and league, with the historical frequency behind every percentage. Not a bookmaker.

hero.title: Football statistics to understand every match
hero.lead: Goals, corners, cards, shots, fouls and referees by team and league, with the historical frequency behind every percentage.

leagues.title: Choose a league
leagues.subtitle: Select a card to see its upcoming matches.

stats.title: What you can analyse
stats.subtitle: Each statistic has its own page, with every team's percentage and the matches behind it.

blurb.goals: Over and under goals for the match, the team or the opponent.
blurb.result: How often each team wins, draws or loses.
blurb.htFt: The half-time result crossed with the full-time result.
blurb.cleanSheet: Matches in which the team didn't concede.
blurb.corners: Match and team corners, plus handicap.
blurb.cards: Yellows and reds for the match and for each team.
blurb.bookingPoints: Yellow 10 points, red 25: the total per match.
blurb.shots: Total shots, on target or not, for the match and for each team.
blurb.shotsOnTarget: Shots on target only, for the match and for each team.
blurb.fouls: Fouls committed in the match and by each team.
blurb.referees: Cards, booking points, corners and goals by referee.

chooseMatch.title: Choose a league and a match
chooseMatch.text: Start with your league's matchday and open the match you want to look at.

checkSample.title: Look at the statistic and its sample
checkSample.text: Every percentage comes with the number of matches it's based on: overall, at home and away.

interpret.title: Read it with care
interpret.text: It's what happened before, not what will happen. With few matches, a high percentage tells you little.

trust.title: How to read the percentages
trust.text: The percentages on Statistics 4 Bets are <bold>historical frequency</bold>, not a promise of what will happen: they count how often something happened before and should be read alongside the number of matches used. A high percentage from a few matches says much less than the same percentage from many.
